chunks: Al-Husayn ibn Muhammad from Mu'alla ibn Muhammad from Al-Wassha from Dawud al-Hammarr from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) who said:
Whoever frequently remembers Allah, Mighty and Majestic, Allah will shade him in His Paradise.
ai.seo_question: What is the reward for frequently remembering Allah?
ai.summary: In al-Kafi, Shaykh al-Kulayni links this narration to the concept of divine shelter, where the 'shade' symbolizes protection from the heat of reckoning and the trials of the grave. This aligns with Shia scholarly emphasis on dhikr as a means of sustaining spiritual tranquility (sakina) and securing a prominent place in the eternal abode.
